title: Record check-in
purpose: Return a checked-out specimen to a free storage position, say who has it now and state explicitly whether a thaw was observed.
summary: Return a checked-out specimen to a free position, say who has it now and state whether a thaw was observed.

tasks.title: Check the specimen in
steps: Choose the [[Box]] and type the free [[Position]] label.
Choose the [[Custodian after check-in]] and answer [[Was a thaw observed while it was out?]].

tasks.title: Store a returned specimen
steps: After a return from outside the repository, use this same form to put it back in storage.

good_to_know: The thaw question has no preset answer. Record only what was observed; choose Not known if nobody knows.
Check-in closes the time out of storage.
The position is rechecked when you save, so a position taken meanwhile is refused.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: Admin, manager and technician can use this form; a viewer is refused.

When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice giving the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee.

The top of the form repeats the specimen ID (a link back to the record), status including any active holds, amount on hand and location, so you can confirm you are acting on the right specimen. The location reads Checked out to the person and destination while checked out, Returned, in hand of the person who received it (with where it came back from) after a return from outside the repository, and Distributed: outside the repository while it is away in a shipment.

It is available while the specimen is checked out, and after a distributed specimen was returned to the repository: the return leaves it in hand of the staff member who received it, and this form stores it. For a returned specimen a note says where it came back from; time since the return counts as time out of storage, and the thaws reported for the time away were already recorded with the return, so answer the thaw question only for what was observed since. A distributed specimen (sent out of the repository in a shipment) is refused until its return is recorded.

items.label: Box
items.description: Active boxes, shown with their storage unit, rack path and number of free positions.

items.label: Position
items.description: The position label inside the box, such as A1; capitals do not matter. The help text lists up to 12 free positions (nothing is reserved). The position must exist, be free and not blocked, and is checked again under lock when you save, so someone else may take it first. A box without a label, or a label without a box, is refused.

items.label: Custodian after check-in
items.description: Required. The active staff member responsible for it from now on; starts as you.

items.label: Was a thaw observed while it was out?
items.description: Required, no preset answer: Yes, a thaw was observed; No thaw was observed; or Not known. Leaving storage is not a thaw, so record only what was observed. Yes adds one observed thaw to the thaw records; No and Not known add none, and Not known is kept distinct from No. Observed thaws recorded here must not be entered again as a separate observed thaw.

items.label: Checked in at
items.description: Required. Repository local time to the second; not in the future and not before the specimen's last recorded event.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, up to 2,000 characters. Kept in the history with the change. Do not enter names, record numbers, birth dates, contact details or other text that could identify a donor.

sections.title: Saving and rules
paragraphs: Record check-in places the specimen in the chosen position, closes the open check-out or return (ending its time out of storage) and records the custodian change and the thaw answer together. Hidden revision numbers are captured when the form opens. If the specimen was changed by someone else meanwhile, the save is refused with “Specimen VP-… changed since you opened it. Reload it, check the current state and try again” (or, for storage changes, “The specimen's storage location changed since you opened this page… Reload it and try again”). Nothing is saved; reopen the form from the specimen record to pick up the current state before entering the action again.

Times are repository local time, entered to the second. A time cannot be in the future or before the specimen's latest recorded event (the message names that event's time). A time within the same second as that event is taken as that event's own time, so recording straight after another event keeps the order. The form starts at the current time.
